men.summary: The Bluejays sit at 2-1 after an 89-82 road loss at Kansas State on Nov. 10, following home wins over Kansas City (76-61) and Le Moyne (83-55), and their NET ranking of 83 (RPI 184) reflects a thin early résumé with no Quadrant 1 games played yet. With Big East play still ahead at 0-0, their postseason outlook is wide open but unproven, since they'll need to collect quality conference wins to climb from the bubble's outer edge into NCAA Tournament consideration.

women.summary: At 2-1 with a NET of 91 and an RPI of 82, the Bluejays have a perfect 2-0 road record, including a 73-71 win at South Dakota State that stands as their 1-0 Quadrant 1 mark, but they are coming off a 54-49 neutral-site loss to South Dakota on Nov. 11. With Big East play still ahead (0-0) and a NET outside the typical at-large range, their postseason outlook is wide open, and they will likely need a strong conference showing to build an NCAA Tournament case.
